text: Sindh Madrassatul Islam Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Sindh Madrassatul Islam Type: Monument - Building Province: Sindh District: Karachi Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: This building was constructed by Hassan Ali Effendi and inaugurated on 1 September 1885. The Father of the Nation also received education in this school. This was founded on an ancient site of Qafila Sarai - a famous caravan station in Karachi.
